name: Fujiwara no Sanekata
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 51); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: Though love, like blisters made from leaves
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sanekata
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 51
poems.text:
Though love, like blisters made from leaves
Grown on Mount Ibuki,
Torments me more than I can say,
My lady shall not see,
How she is paining me.
